The '''Soldier''' is a class in featured in ''[[Battlefield Heroes]]''. It combines aspect of the the [[Assault]] and [[Medic]] kits. The Soldier is capable of utilizing [[Submachine gun|submachine guns]], [[Shotgun|shotguns]], and pistols. Soldiers start with 110 health points and are also capable of using [[Syringe#Battlefield Heroes|Dr. Ned's Needle/Dr. Siegfried's Syringe]]. This allows them to [[Support action#Healing|heal]] teammates and increase maximum health.

===Abilities===
The Soldier has 5 abilities:
{| border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="width: 100%; "
|<center>[[File:6 Sense.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Soldier|Sixth Sense]]: You and your team will be able to see the location of all nearby enemies for a short time.
|-
|<center>[[File:Burning Bullets.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Soldier|Burning Bullets]]: Shots from the player's [[Submachine gun|submachine gun]] will set enemies on fire, slowly taking their health down over time until the fire goes out (or use/receive [[Abilities#Soldier|Combat Medicine]]).
|-
|<center>[[File:Combat Medic.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Soldier|Combat Medicine]]: Instantly [[Support action#Healing|heals]] the player and nearby allies. The amount healed scales to the amount of players healed.
|-
|<center>[[File:Granade Spam.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Soldier|Grenade Spam]]: The player throws multiple [[Grenade|grenades]] at a target.
|-
|<center>[[File:Blasting Strike.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Soldier|Blasting Strike]]: The player strikes with such force that all nearby players and vehicles are thrown aside.
|}
